state.description: Adds a --dry-run flag to the CLI. Added tests in test_cli.py covering the new flag. This is not a breaking change: existing commands are unaffected. To roll back, revert this commit; no data migrations are involved.
Cleans up some old helper functions and renames a few variables for clarity.
Fixes the off-by-one error in the pagination cursor. Added a regression test in test_pagination.py.

Reworks the retry logic; should behave the same in most cases, but the error type raised on final failure has changed from RuntimeError to RetryExhausted, which breaks callers that catch RuntimeError. Ran the existing suite locally.
Migrates the cache backend from in-memory to Redis. If Redis is unavailable in your environment, set CACHE_BACKEND=memory to fall back to the old behavior.

Bumps the JSON schema version and updates the validator. Added new fixture-based tests for the updated schema. Downstream consumers on the old schema version may need to update, not sure if anyone still uses it.
